Table.MORE:

The trading window for dealing in securities of the Bank will remain closed from 25th December, 2019 to 20th January, 2020 (both days inclusive) for the designated employees, directors, etc. pursuant to the applicable SEBI Regulations.

This is for your information and appropriate dissemination.
